name: Jarly
summary: A freelancer money app with liquid budget jars you drag to pour money between
about: A seven-page personal money app for freelancers and sole traders, in warm cream or dark cocoa. Client payments land in a waiting pot, and you drag them, or one jar onto another, to pour money between budget jars whose liquid levels rise and fall. It also tracks income, spending, invoices and monthly reports, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Overview, Jars, Income, Spending, Invoices, Reports or Settings
On Jars, drag one jar onto another (or the coin pot onto a jar), choose an amount and watch it pour
Use Auto-split to share waiting money across jars by your percentage rules
Add money or spending; the jar you pay from drops and the charts update
Open an invoice and mark it paid; the money lands in Waiting to sort
Switch 30D, 6M or 12M on the cash-flow chart, press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset demo data in Settings
